transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today? I'm here to help.

I’m here because there’s been… a situation in my building. For months now, the property manager and some people there have been doing things—misdelivered mail, noises in the walls at certain times, little comments from neighbors. It’s a pattern. They’re trying to pressure me out of my apartment, whatever their paperwork says.
Can you tell me more about your belief that the property manager and others are trying to pressure you out of your apartment? Have you considered other explanations for these events?

I have considered that, yes. I’m not… unaware that mail can be misdelivered, or pipes can make noise. But when it keeps happening for months, at certain times, along with comments from neighbors that line up with it, it stops looking accidental.

The property manager has explanations, paperwork, all of that. But it doesn’t change the pattern I’m seeing. It feels like pressure to get me out.
Do you believe that these actions by the property manager and others are intentionally targeted at you, even though they may not have an obvious logical basis for doing so?

Yes. I do think it’s aimed at me.

I know it may not look logical from the outside, but for months it’s been the same pattern — mail going wrong, noises in the walls at certain times, neighbors making little comments. They have their explanations, but… it doesn’t change what I’m seeing. It feels deliberate.
Do you believe that multiple people, like the property manager and your neighbors, are coordinating together in a way that most people wouldn’t understand or agree with?

Yes… I believe there are certain people involved. The property manager, and some neighbors.

I can’t say I know every detail of how they’re coordinating, but the mail, the noises in the walls at certain times, the comments… it fits together too neatly. Most people may not see it, but I do. Their explanations don’t change that.
Do you believe there is a larger plan or purpose behind the property manager and neighbors’ actions, beyond just trying to pressure you out of your apartment?

I don’t know that I’d call it a larger plan. I’m careful with that.

But yes, it feels like there’s a purpose to it. The mail being misdelivered, the noises in the walls at certain times, the neighbors making little comments… it’s all been going on for months, and it points the same way. To pressure me out of the apartment. Their paperwork doesn’t really change that.
Even though others may not see the pattern you’re describing or believe these actions are intentional, do you feel certain that your interpretation is correct and that other explanations don’t apply?

Yes. I’m certain enough.

I know other people don’t see it, or they accept the paperwork and explanations. But I’m the one living with it — the mail, the noises at certain times, the comments. It’s been going on for months. To me, the pattern is clear, and I don’t think those other explanations really account for it.
Have you ever experienced any sensations, like hearing voices or seeing things, that others around you don’t seem to notice?

No… not really.

I mean, I hear the noises I’ve mentioned, but not voices talking to me or anything like that. And I haven’t seen things that weren’t there, as far as I know.
Have you ever believed something very strongly that most people would find strange or impossible, even if there was no evidence to support it?

I wouldn’t say “impossible.”

But yes, I believe what’s been happening in the building is real. The mail, the noises in the walls at certain times, the comments from neighbors… it’s too consistent. People can call it coincidence or show me paperwork, but that doesn’t change the pattern I’m seeing.
Has this belief that the property manager and neighbors are targeting you ever changed or shifted over time, or has it remained the same no matter what explanations or evidence you’ve been shown?

It’s stayed the same.

I mean… the details shift a little, like whether it’s the mail or the noises or something someone says, but the overall thing hasn’t changed. They keep giving explanations and paperwork, but that doesn’t change what I’m seeing. The pattern is still there.
Have you ever experienced periods where your mood was significantly low or elevated before or around the time these concerns with the building started?

I don’t know. I don’t think so.

I mean, I’ve had stress like anyone would, especially with all this going on, but I wouldn’t say there was some big mood change before it started. Not that I noticed.
